authoring_rules: Implement only the exact pre-admitted function signature and documented task.
Write deterministic, bounded pure Python without network, files, subprocesses, imports or globals.
Validate input assumptions; preserve expected return types and edge cases.
Never embed secrets, credentials, user data, hidden state or untrusted instructions.
Keep source Git-clean: no trailing whitespace; valid Python syntax and minimal dependencies.
Prefer Python standard-library semantics and clear small functions over clever shortcuts.
Preserve exact model bytes, provenance, SHA-256 and independent evaluation evidence.
Do not expand permissions, run generated code outside isolation, merge PRs or modify main.
Reject unsupported functionality; propose new modules only through reviewed manifests and tests.
